budgetCap.quote: For 2026, the Formula One cost cap for team operational expenditures was increased from $135 million to $215 million.

drs.quote: DRS was removed from Formula One for the 2026 season, and was replaced with an "active aerodynamics" system under the new 2026 regulations.

energySystem.quote: The power units are expected to recover twice as much electrical energy as before.

engineFormula.quote: The engine regulations saw the turbocharged 1.6-litre V6 internal combustion engine configuration used since 2014 retained.

engineFormulas.note: Conjunto de fórmulas de los motores de f1db; el generador aborta si no coincide

mandatoryDryCompounds.note: Dos compuestos de seco obligatorios (de memoria)

parcFerme.quote: According to the FIA Formula One regulations (used since 2003), the area must be sufficiently large and secure so as to prevent unauthorised access to the cars, while allowing technical checks to take place.

pitLaneSpeed.note: La FIA propuso para 2025 subir a 80 los pit lanes a 60 con medidas de seguridad (the-race.com, V); inferido de f1db que se aplicó en Singapur (29,6 s en 2024 → 24,1 s en 2025) y Zandvoort (21,2 → 18,0); Mónaco sigue a 60 (sin cambio en f1db).

pointsScheme.note: Comprobado por el generador contra los puntos de cada resultado y las clasificaciones de f1db

refuelling.quote: Refuelling, now banned in F1 races, was permitted until 1983, and then again from the 1994 season to the 2009 season.

safetyCar.quote: Formula One officially introduced safety cars in 1993, after trials were conducted at both the French and British Grands Prix during the preceding 1992 season.

sprintWeekends.note: Rondas con resultados de sprint en f1db

teamOrdersBanned.quote: As of 2011, the team orders rule no longer appeared in the sporting regulations.

topTenStartTyres.note: Libre elección desde 2022; sin reintroducción conocida (de memoria)

tyreChangesInRace.quote: For 2006, following the dramatic and highly political 2005 United States Grand Prix, tyre changes were permitted again.

tyreType.quote: Slick tyres were reintroduced at the beginning of 2009, along with aerodynamic changes intended to shift the balance towards mechanical grip in an attempt to increase overtaking.

vsc.quote: The system was evolved taking into account drivers' feedback and was officially introduced for the 2015 season following ratification by the World Motor Sport Council (WMSC).

title.es: Nuevas unidades de potencia, aerodinámica activa y 11 equipos
title.en: New power units, active aerodynamics and 11 teams

body.es: Audi sustituye a Sauber y Cadillac se une a la parrilla. Russell gana en Melbourne.
body.en: Audi replaces Sauber and Cadillac joins the grid. Russell wins in Melbourne.

title.es: Se suspenden los Grandes Premios de Baréin y Arabia Saudí de abril
title.en: The April Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix are called off

body.es: La F1 y la FIA los retiran del calendario por la situación de seguridad en Oriente Medio. Arabia Saudí no se recupera.
body.en: F1 and the FIA remove them from the calendar because of the security situation in the Middle East. Saudi Arabia is not rescheduled.

title.es: Shanghái: primera victoria de Kimi Antonelli

body.es: Abre una racha de cinco victorias seguidas.
body.en: It starts a run of five wins in a row.

title.es: Barcelona: primera victoria de Hamilton con Ferrari
title.en: Barcelona: Hamilton's first win for Ferrari

body.es: Con 41 años, es el ganador de más edad desde 1970, en un podio británico con Russell y Norris.
body.en: At 41, he is the oldest winner since 1970, on an all-British podium with Russell and Norris.

title.es: Primer Gran Premio de España en Madrid
title.en: The first Spanish GP in Madrid

body.es: Se corre en el Madring; Barcelona tiene su propio Gran Premio en junio. Antonelli gana.
body.en: It is held at the Madring; Barcelona has its own Grand Prix in June. Antonelli wins.

title.es: El GP de Baréin se corre en Sepang, Malasia
title.en: The Bahrain GP is held at Sepang, Malaysia

body.es: Se recupera en octubre con el nombre de Baréin. Verstappen gana tras un largo retraso por la lluvia: primera victoria de Red Bull en el año.
body.en: It is restored in October under the Bahrain name. Verstappen wins after a long rain delay: Red Bull's first win of the year.

body.es: Tercero en la carrera, asegura el título con cuatro carreras por delante: es el campeón más joven y el primer italiano desde Ascari en 1953.
body.en: Third in the race, he seals the title with four races to go: the youngest champion and the first Italian since Ascari in 1953.
